In Linux run this simple script in node:

#!/usr/bin/env node
var net = require('net');
net.createServer(function(socket) {
socket.on('data',function(data) {
 console.log('\n');
 console.log(data.toString());
 });
}).listen(9500);

Now use your "Networking" admin panel to set a manual proxy. On the socks host line set the host to 127.0.0.1 for port 9500. Run the script. Browse the internet.
